name: Akari Tanaka
bio:
Akari Tanaka is a highly experienced paint shop specialist who has been involved in motorsport for over two decades. She began her career at a local automotive body shop, quickly developing a passion for the precision and artistry involved in creating flawless finishes. Her attention to detail caught the eye of a junior racing team, who recruited her to manage the paintwork on their Formula Ford cars. 

Akari's approach is rooted in a deep understanding of both traditional techniques and cutting-edge technologies. She meticulously researches new paint types, application methods, and protective coatings to ensure Proton by Premotion always has a competitive edge. Her innovative solutions, such as developing a lighter, more durable paint for aerodynamic components, have consistently improved the team's performance. She now manages a team of junior painters, passing on her valuable experience.

What sets Akari apart is her relentless pursuit of perfection and her ability to troubleshoot complex paint issues under immense pressure. She is known for her calm demeanor and analytical approach, which allows her to find creative solutions even in the most challenging situations.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled bob with subtle waves
physical.description: Akari is of average height and build with a composed and focused expression.
